=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2329-2337 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `validation_owner_signature` fallback runs the summary through `error-signature`, which returns the literal "no-error-lines" when no pattern matches, so the `[ -n "${signature}" ]` guard never fires and the first-line fallback is dead code.
  WHY: Unrelated failures with the same stage and reason share one fingerprint, owner marker and bounce key, so a bounce for one failure can suppress the harness report for another. Severity disagreement: reviewers reported MAJOR throughout, and I mapped MAJOR to high.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:5464 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The empty-string default substitution for `HARNESS_FIXES` in the `harness_error` branch is not gated by `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED`/`validation_owner_enabled`.
  WHY: With the switch off and `harness_fixes` equal to "", output differs from today's, which breaks the "behave exactly as today" guarantee. Severity disagreement: NIT from most reviewers, MAJOR from qwen; the highest is used.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2577-2579 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `validation_owner_split_mixed` skips the split when the classifier reports `truncated: true`, so harness-owned fix issues stay in the diagnosis and reach the consumer fix-up.
  WHY: The requirement is to keep only project-owned fix issues for the consumer fix-up. Severity disagreement: NIT from anthropic, MAJOR from openai and qwen, and gemini gave no severity; the highest is used. The line range 2577-2579 comes from openai and qwen. Gemini cited 5410-5420 for the same function, and anthropic cited no lines.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2287-2288 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The new paginated bounce-marker comment read in `validation_owner_load_bounced` omits `per_page=100`, and it duplicates the existing `PRIOR_COMMENTS` fetch at lines 4441-4442.
  WHY: It adds roughly 84 page requests against shared GitHub API quota on very large tracking issues. Severity disagreement: NIT from minimax, MAJOR from openai; the highest is used. The two reviewers state different root causes (missing `per_page` versus a duplicated fetch), so this entry combines them on the same call.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2289 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The default case in `validation_owner_fixed` only echoes a warning and returns.
  WHY: Execution continues with potentially inconsistent `VALIDATION_HARNESS_REASON` or `VALIDATION_HARNESS_STAGE` state when `validation_owner_merge_fields` runs later; the reviewer says it should fail closed. The source gave no severity, so low is an assumption.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Add two optional fields to the schema and the status rules: fix_issues[].files (consumer-relative paths) and harness_files (paths the harness fix touches)."
  expected_change_site: scripts/validate_process.sh (`validation_owner_classify`), prompts/mode-validate-diagnose.txt
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: gemini says `scripts/validate_process.sh` does not read the fields or pass them to the classifier. Qwen says the fields are in the prompts and contract and the classifier reads them from the diagnosis JSON, but the status rules do not mention them. Anthropic checked the same claim and found it does not hold, because `validation_owner_classify` passes `--diagnosis-json` and the classifier reads both fields. This gap is therefore disputed.
- requirement: "Add tests/test_validate_process_owner_routing.py ... Cover harness reclassification, the mixed split, the bounce guard, the owner marker, the status/metadata fields, and the switch off leaving behaviour unchanged."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_validate_process_owner_routing.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The tests do not exercise the optional `files` or `harness_files` fields in the diagnosis file or the metadata/status output. Qwen notes the test data includes `files` but no test verifies the classifier uses it.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2329-2337 (`validation_owner_signature` fallback block) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback runs the failure summary through `error-signature`, which returns "no-error-lines" and never an empty string (workflow_failure_heal.py:2847-2861), so the `[ -n "${signature}" ]` guard never fires and the first-line fallback is dead code.
  WHY: Different failures with the same stage and reason get the same `harness_fp`, owner marker and bounce key, so one bounce marker can suppress an unrelated report and the heal intake can merge unrelated failures. The tests stub `error-signature`, so they do not catch this.
- scripts/validate_process.sh (`validation_owner_split_mixed`, the `truncated` check at the top of the function) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: With `owner=mixed` and `truncated=true`, the split is skipped and every fix issue stays in the diagnosis; the classifier (workflow_failure_heal.py:1720-1726) puts an issue with truncated files on the project side.
  WHY: Harness-owned fix issues can still reach the consumer fix-up. The reviewer calls this a deliberate fail-safe for unusually large diagnoses and a known limitation, not a regression.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:5464 (`harness_error` branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The empty-string default substitution for `HARNESS_FIXES` is not gated by the switch.
  WHY: With `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED=false` and an empty `harness_fixes`, the tracking comment and `failure_summary` text differ from before. The reviewer says the autofix editor added this change in the last run.
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE. The reviewer checked the pass-1 claim that `files` and `harness_files` are not read or passed to the classifier and found it does not hold.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/validate_process.sh, `validation_owner_signature` fallback. After the `error-signature` call, add `[ "${signature}" != "no-error-lines" ] || signature="$(head -n 1 "${tail_file}" | cut -c1-200)"` (about 2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:5464 (in last_run_diff.patch) | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The default text "Validation harness needs correction." is applied to `HARNESS_FIXES` even when `VALIDATION_HARNESS_HEAL_ENABLED` is `false`.
  WHY: This changes the output text for the healing-disabled branch and breaks the backward-compatibility guarantee.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:5410-5420 (in `validation_owner_split_mixed`) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The logic checks `.truncated // false` and skips the split if it is true, leaving all issues in the diagnosis.
  WHY: The consumer fix-up then includes harness-owned issues, which violates the project-owned versus harness-owned separation.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2289 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The default case in `validation_owner_fixed` only echoes a warning and returns.
  WHY: Execution continues with potentially inconsistent `VALIDATION_HARNESS_REASON` or `VALIDATION_HARNESS_STAGE` when `validation_owner_merge_fields` is called later; it should fail closed.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Add two optional fields to the schema and the status rules: fix_issues[].files (consumer-relative paths) and harness_files (paths the harness fix touches)."
  Expected change site: scripts/validate_process.sh (`validation_owner_classify` and related logic)
  Evidence of absence: The fields were added to the prompt templates, but `scripts/validate_process.sh` is not reading these fields from the diagnosis result file nor passing them into the `workflow_failure_heal.py` classifier as input.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Add tests/test_validate_process_owner_routing.py ... Cover ... the status/metadata fields" (implying the optional fields added to schema/rules).
  Expected change site: tests/test_validate_process_owner_routing.py
  Evidence of absence: The added tests cover the basic owner classification, mixed-split logic and the marker, but they do not exercise the `files` or `harness_files` fields in the diagnosis file or the metadata/status file output.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2329-2336 (the dead line is 2335), against scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:2847-2861 and 6747-6752 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `error_signature()` returns the literal "no-error-lines" whenever no `_SIGNATURE_PATTERNS` bucket matches, so the `[ -n "${signature}" ] || signature="$(head -n 1 ...)"` fallback at line 2335 can never fire. Real fallback summaries such as the renderer_exit 10/11/12/13/15 texts and `sandbox_helper_missing` all collapse to that value.
  WHY: `validation_failure_fingerprint()` (workflow_failure_heal.py:1580-1586) then gives every distinct `generate_failed` and `sandbox_unavailable` cause one fingerprint. `classify_validation_owner` (workflow_failure_heal.py:1738-1742) flips the owner to `none`/`bounced_repeat` on a match, so a bounce for one failure suppresses an unrelated one, and the heal intake dedups them into one lineage. The accompanying test stubs `error-signature`, so it cannot catch this.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:2287 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new paginated comment read `gh_retry gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/issues/${TRACKING_ISSUE_NUM}/comments" --paginate --jq ...` omits `?per_page=100`. The reviewer says 33 existing call sites pass it, for example scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3475 and 3654, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:999, scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh:634 and scripts/plan_split_dispatch.sh:102.
  WHY: `validation_owner_load_bounced` runs on every tracking validation cycle, and at about 2,500 comments the read costs about 84 API calls instead of about 25 against the shared `GH_PAT` quota.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:5464 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq change substitutes the default text for an empty `harness_fixes`, and the line sits outside the `validation_owner_enabled` guard. In jq, `//` treats only `null` and `false` as absent, so the old expression returned "".
  WHY: With the switch off, the tracking comment's "Harness fix guidance" section and `failure_summary` change, contradicting "With `false`, the run must behave exactly as today".
- TASK COMPLETENESS / INTENT GAPS: NONE
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
